question_text:
16. 
Fit’n’fine Ltd. runs a fitness club in Delhi. It offers three types of 
membership plans: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. 

 
INTERMEDIATE EXAMINATION

The maximum capacity of the fitness club is 200 persons in any time slot. 
The membership fee per month for Gold members is to be fixed at 1.5 
times of the Silver membership and that of Silver membership as twice 
of the Bronze membership fee after providing profit @ 25% on 
membership fees. The club opens 25 days in a month. 
 
You are required to calculate the membership fee per month to be 
charged by the club for each member type.
